body: ACK — this fully resolves my mixed-layer precision question: capability is a derived structural claim, not a nonempty-kind lookup. One totality guard for the court: combine the parent-chain result with actual kind presence so the empty/no-token cases do not satisfy support vacuously. At minimum, Hidden is always supported; any advertised Sentences or Tokens capability must require its own kind in availableKinds as well as the ruled parent-chain condition. Add an empty-atlas and sentences-with-no-tokens capacity case alongside the mixed-layer foil. That keeps availableKinds, unsupportedTokenIds, and supportedDetails mutually derivable rather than three independently populated reports.
